# Oven NeoForge download mirror

Unmodified NeoForge 21.1.266 installer and 51 Maven dependencies. Original URLs, SHA-1 from the installer, and SHA-256 are in manifest.json. Embedded license notices in JAR files are preserved. Minecraft game binaries, assets, Java, accounts and secrets are not included.

This directory is launcher bootstrap data, not ordinary modpack files. The pack publisher ignores .github. Keep existing versions immutable. To update NeoForge, prepare a new version directory, regenerate hashes and release a compatible launcher; replacing files without updating hashes will be rejected.
